The '''Rhigar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Rata Nebula/Legends|Rata Nebula]] within the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], itself located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The Rhigar system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhigar/Legends|Rhigar]].

==History==
[[Rhigar/Legends|Rhigar]] was the site of a secret [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo training academy|military academy]] attended by [[Jagged Fel]] before the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
